note: NOMINAL values from public sources (see each platform's source; main reference: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap.docx). Edit freely: every value can also be changed per drone in the Asset tab. Units: altitudes km above sea level, angles degrees, speed km/h, endurance hours, range km, detection km, loiter minutes. Fuel = range_km when published, else cruise speed x endurance. operational_range_km (data-link radius) and max_speed_kmh are informational. Target categories (target_categories) give each target letter a meaning; sensor figures are per category. Left out: RQ-170 (speed/range not published), RQ-180 (unconfirmed estimates).

platforms.name: RQ-11 Raven
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [1]: max 95 km/h, 10 km operational range (data link), 2 h (source also says 60-90 min — flagged), 4,500 m ceiling, hand launch. Cruise, operating altitude (flies ~500 ft above ground) and angles assumed.

platforms.name: RQ-20 Puma
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [2]: max 83 km/h, 15 km operational range, 2 h, 3,200 m ceiling, hand launch (baseline variant). Cruise ~60% of max, operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: RQ-7 Shadow
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [3]: max 200 km/h, 109 km operational range, 9 h, 4,600 m ceiling, catapult launch / arresting-gear recovery. Cruise, operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: RQ-21 Blackjack
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [4]: max 170 km/h, 93 km operational range, 16 h, 5,900 m ceiling, rail launch / Skyhook recovery. Cruise (55 kt), operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: RQ-5 Hunter
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [5]: max 170 km/h, 125 km operational range, 21 h, 5,500 m ceiling, conventional runway + arresting gear. Cruise ~60% of max, operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: RQ-101 Night Intruder
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [6]: cruise 150 km/h, max 185, 110-200 km operating range, 6 h, 4,500 m ceiling; launch/recovery not specified (runway M assumed). Operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: MQ-1B Predator
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [7] (USAF): cruise 84 mph, max 135 mph, range 770 mi, 25,000 ft ceiling, 5,000 ft runway. Endurance not in the USAF table (24 h commonly reported). Operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: MQ-9A Reaper
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [8][9] (USAF, GA-ASI): 240 KTAS, 27+ h, up to 50,000 ft, range 1,150 mi baseline (1,611 mi ER); EO/IR (MTS-B), multimode radar, ESM option. Cruise (169 kt), operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: RQ-4 Global Hawk
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [10] (USAF, Oct 2014): 310 kt, range 12,300 nmi, >34 h, 60,000 ft; EO, IR, SAR, MTI, SIGINT (block dependent). Operating altitude (55,000 ft) and angles assumed.

platforms.name: MQ-4C Triton
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [13]: max 610 km/h, 15,200 km operational range, 30 h, 16,800 m ceiling; AESA maritime radar, EO/IR, AIS, passive ESM. Cruise (310 kt), operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: X-47B (demonstrator)
platforms.source: Representative_UAS_Specifications_ISR_Planner_Roadmap [15]: technology demonstrator — max 1,102 km/h, 3,900 km range, 6 h, 12,800 m ceiling, carrier catapult / arrested landing; sensors are reported provisions, not a production suite. Cruise ~60% of max, operating altitude and angles assumed.

platforms.name: MQ-1C Gray Eagle
platforms.source: Public figures (29,000 ft ceiling, 25 h); cruise speed and climb/descent angles assumed. Not in the roadmap document.

platforms.name: MQ-9B SkyGuardian
platforms.source: Approximate public figures (40+ h, 40,000 ft ceiling, 210 kt max); cruise speed, operating altitude and climb/descent angles assumed. Not in the roadmap document.

platforms.name: ScanEagle
platforms.source: Approximate public figures (catapult launch; 60 kt, 18+ h, 19,500 ft ceiling); operating altitude and climb/descent angles assumed. Not in the roadmap document.
